After the call, invoke getSchemaLoader() again and assert that the returned reference is identical (==) to the one captured before the schema retrieval. This ensures that other factory operations do not replace or recreate the loader.

cases.expected: all concurrently‑executed calls return the identical SchemaLoader reference
cases.description: Create a JsonSchemaFactory (default builder). Start N (e.g., 10) threads that each invoke getSchemaLoader() and store the result in a thread‑local variable. After all threads complete, verify that every stored reference is == to the reference obtained in the main thread before starting the workers. This validates that getSchemaLoader() is safe to call from multiple threads and does not produce distinct loader instances.
